items.title: Hyderabad’s groundwater risky for kids, shows high nitrate and fluoride levels: Study
items.summary: Groundwater in several parts of Hyderabad has elevated levels of nitrate and fluoride, with children facing higher potential non-carcinogenic health risks, according to a recent study. The study analysed 44 groundwater samples collected during the pre-monsoon and post-monsoon seasons of 2023. According to a TNIE report , nitrate exceeded the permissible drinking-water limit of 45 mg/L in 36% of the samples collected before monsoon and 40% of the samples collected after monsoon. Nitrate concentrations ranged from 3 to 230 mg/L during the pre-monsoon period and from 5 to 797 mg/L post-monsoon, with higher levels mainly recorded in southwestern and central parts of the city. Researchers attributed nitrate contamination largely to fertiliser use, sewage infiltration, septic-tank leakage and urban wastewater. Monsoon rainfall can also carry nitrogen compounds from the soil into groundwater, the study noted. Fluoride exceeded the acceptable limit of 1 mg/L in 64% of pre-monsoon samples and 59% of post-monsoon samples. items.title: BRICS explained: The bloc’s origins, members and its challenge to the global order
items.summary: The flags of Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa and other countries were lined up in New Delhi this weekend as leaders gathered for the 18th BRICS Summit. Hosted by India on September 12 and 13, the summit came at a time of heightened geopolitical tensions, wars in West Asia and Ukraine, US tariffs and growing debates over who gets to shape the global economic and political order. The group adopted a 140-paragraph New Delhi Declaration, covering issues ranging from global trade and sanctions to artificial intelligence, critical minerals, health, climate change and reform of international institutions. The declaration also called for restraint in West Asia, criticised unilateral tariffs and sanctions, and backed reforms to the global financial and trading systems without naming the countries involved. But what exactly is BRICS? Why was it formed? And is it really a challenge to the US-led global order? What is BRICS? BRICS is a grouping of major emerging economies that cooperate on political, economic and development issues.
